|---|---|---|---|
| **Style** `style` | Normal | Normal, Fixed ratio, Fixed size | How dragging sets the shape. |
| **Ratio width** `ratioWidth` | 1 | 0.01 to 1000 | Width part of the fixed ratio. |
| **Ratio height** `ratioHeight` | 1 | 0.01 to 1000 | Height part of the fixed ratio. |
| **Width** `sizeWidth` | 64 | 1 to 16384 px | Width of the fixed size. |
| **Height** `sizeHeight` | 64 | 1 to 16384 px | Height of the fixed size. |
